playstyle.identity: Kai'Sa is an evolving ADC who upgrades abilities by buying stats. She excels at diving into fights with her ultimate and bursting isolated targets.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive procs plasma on 5 hits for burst. Abilities evolve at stat thresholds (Q at AD, W at AP, E at attack speed). Q fires missiles (more on isolated). W long-range poke. E gives speed and invisibility when evolved. R dashes to any plasma-marked enemy. Evolve Q first.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Kai'Sa spikes at each evolution. Q evolve at Kraken makes her dangerous. She's strong mid-late with all evolutions.

passive.name: Second Skin
passive.summary: Attacks and abilities stack plasma; at 5 stacks, proc for burst damage.
passive.details: Kai'Sa's attacks and abilities apply plasma stacks. Ally CC also adds stacks. At 5 stacks, the target takes bonus magic damage. She also evolves abilities at stat thresholds.

abilities.name: Icathian Rain
abilities.summary: Fire missiles that prioritize nearby enemies; more damage on isolated targets.
abilities.details: Kai'Sa fires missiles at nearby enemies. Missiles prioritize champions and deal more damage to isolated targets. Evolves to fire more missiles.

abilities.name: Void Seeker
abilities.summary: Fire a long-range skillshot that marks for plasma and reveals.
abilities.details: Kai'Sa fires a bolt that damages, reveals, and applies plasma stacks. Evolves to apply more stacks and have lower cooldown on hit.

abilities.name: Supercharge
abilities.summary: Gain movement speed and attack speed; evolved grants invisibility.
abilities.details: Kai'Sa charges up, gaining movement speed. After charging, she gains attack speed. Evolves to grant brief invisibility during charge.

abilities.name: Killer Instinct
abilities.summary: Dash to any enemy with plasma stacks, gaining a shield.
abilities.details: Kai'Sa dashes to a location near an enemy champion with plasma, gaining a damage-absorbing shield.
